_comment: Explicit indexation policy per route type. Read by lib/routes.mjs (meta robots, X-Robots-Tag) and the sitemap handlers. Change values here, not in templates.

cityHubUnverified._comment: Hubs for places with no match in the 2023 Census Gazetteer (placeType 'unverified' in cities.json: unincorporated communities or neighborhoods). Live and crawlable, excluded from the sitemap until the place and service availability are verified.

cityService._comment: Template-only pages (city name substituted into one shared template). Kept live and crawlable, excluded from the sitemap. Recommended next step after reviewing Search Console data: set index=false (noindex, follow) for pages with no impressions.
